sections.title: Upcoming *classes*
sections.intro: Classes meet in the shop. A deposit holds your spot; patterns and materials are sold separately unless noted, so stop in beforehand to pick out your fabric.

items.name: Snowman Appliqué
items.desc: Friday, Nov 20 · 10 am. Turn a favorite shirt or sweatshirt into something fun for winter with raw-edge appliqué and embellishments. Bring your own shirt.

items.name: Block of the Month: Choose Happiness
items.desc: Saturdays, Nov 21 and Dec 19 · 10 am. A new quilt block each month, building skills and confidence along the way. Good for every skill level.

items.name: Beginner Sewing
items.desc: Tuesday, Nov 24 · 10 am. Learn your way around a sewing machine while making a simple, practical tote bag from fat quarters.

items.name: The Big Giant Bow
items.desc: Friday and Saturday, Dec 4–5 · 10 am, two sessions. An oversized fabric bow for holidays, décor or gifts. Materials and pattern sold separately.

items.name: Beginner Quilt 2.0
items.desc: Wednesday, Dec 9 · 10 am. Read a quilt pattern, cut and sew squares and rectangles accurately, and master the quarter-inch seam. Materials run about $50.

items.name: Blossoms Appliqué with Jennifer McClanahan
items.desc: Saturday, Dec 12 · 10 am. A small quilt with the award-winning teacher from Sweet Tea Pattern Company, in hand needle-turn or machine appliqué. Kit sold separately.

items.name: Friend and Me Tote Panel
items.desc: Wednesday, Dec 30 · 10 am. Bring a parent or friend and sew a printed panel tote together, kids and grown-ups side by side.

sections.title: Rooted in sewing, *creativity and community*
body: The Vintage Bobbin was created to welcome makers of all skill levels, from people learning to sew for the first time to those who have been creating for years. We believe sewing is more than a craft: it's a way to slow down, connect and create with intention.

The shop pairs curated fabrics, notions and tools with vintage touches that honor the history of the craft. Through classes, workshops and creative gatherings we hope to be a comfortable place to learn, ask questions and share what you're making.
We can't wait to meet you. — Tanya & Kailie
